title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the pattern of the data points in the scatterplot. Consider how the function $$f(x)=x$$ might affect the linearity of the data. Does the pattern suggest a linear relationship?

title: Analyzing $$f(x)=x$$
text: If $$f(x)=x$$, how does this affect the equation $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$? Does it simplify to a linear equation?
